requirement_text: System shall be able to display a walking tour page when the user clicks a Walking Tour link.
user_story: As a visitor, I want a walking tour page to open when I click a Walking Tour link, so that I can see the tour.
technical_task: Link a Walking Tour page from a Walking Tour link.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Walking Tour link, when the user clicks it, then the walking tour page is displayed.
Given the walking tour page, when it is displayed, then it shows the walking tour.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. The page content is not described.

requirement_text: Transmission of roll data must occur in under 5 seconds.
user_story: As an instructor, I want roll data transmitted in under 5 seconds, so that attendance is recorded promptly.
technical_task: Limit the transmission time of roll data to under 5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given roll data to send, when it is transmitted, then the transmission takes under 5 seconds.
Given a transmission that takes 5 seconds or longer, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: If the activation phase is longer than tLEDon, the LED is illuminated.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the LED illuminated when the activation phase is longer than tLEDon, so that a long activation is visible.
technical_task: Switch the LED on when the activation phase lasts longer than tLEDon.
acceptance_criteria: Given the activation phase is longer than tLEDon, when it is evaluated, then the LED is illuminated.
Given the activation phase is not longer than tLEDon, when it is evaluated, then the LED is not illuminated by this rule.

requirement_text: Permit authorized users (who are authorized for emergency situations) to access electronic health information during an emergency.
user_story: As an emergency physician, I want authorized users, authorized for emergency situations, to access electronic health information during an emergency, so that care is not delayed.
technical_task: Permit users who are authorized for emergency situations to access electronic health information while an emergency is in progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given an emergency situation and a user authorized for emergencies, when the user requests electronic health information, then access is permitted.
Given a user who is not authorized for emergency situations, when the user requests electronic health information in an emergency, then emergency access is not permitted.

requirement_text: The system shall include documentation available to the customer that provides guidelines for configuration and use of the security controls necessary to support secure and reliable operation of the system including but not limited to: creation modification and deactivation of user accounts management of roles reset of passwords configuration of password constraints and audit logs.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall include documentation available to the customer that provides guidelines for configuration and use of the security controls necessary to support secure and reliable operation of the system  including but not limited to: creation  modification  and deactivation of user accounts  management of roles  reset of passwords  configuration of password constraints  and audit logs.
user_story: As a customer administrator, I want documentation with guidelines for configuring and using the security controls, so that the system runs securely and reliably.
technical_task: Provide customer documentation covering account creation, modification and deactivation, role management, password resets, password constraint configuration and audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system documentation, when it is reviewed, then it contains guidelines for configuring and using the security controls.

Given the documentation, when it is reviewed, then it covers creation, modification and deactivation of user accounts, management of roles, reset of passwords, configuration of password constraints and audit logs.
rationale: Role assumed: customer administrator. "Including but not limited to" means more topics may be covered.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to select different clefs for a score.
user_story: As a composer, I want to select different clefs for a score, so that I can notate for different instruments.
technical_task: Offer a clef selection for a score.
acceptance_criteria: Given a score, when the user selects a clef, then the score uses that clef.
Given a score using one clef, when the user selects another, then the score shows the new clef.

requirement_text: All numerical requirements stated above are subject to measurable performance monitoring and evaluation.
rationale: The sentence refers to requirements not given and describes a process rather than system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which numerical requirements does "stated above" refer to?
What must the system do to monitor and evaluate performance?

requirement_text: The system shall be able to delete restaurant information upon administrator confirmation.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to delete restaurant information after confirming, so that I do not remove it by accident.
technical_task: Delete restaurant information only after the administrator confirms the action.
acceptance_criteria: Given restaurant information, when the administrator confirms the deletion, then the information is deleted.
Given restaurant information, when the administrator does not confirm, then the information is kept.

requirement_text: Position limits (voltage value position feedback unit): if the plausibility check of the positions limits is longer out of the range of the specifications than the fault tolerance time, the control behaviour must be given (threshold, error message, temporal resolution, temporal correcting errors ).
requirement_text_raw: 4. Position limits (voltage value position feedback unit): if the plausibility check of the positions limits is longer out of the range of the specifications than the fault tolerance time, the control behaviour must be given (threshold, error message, temporal resolution, temporal correcting errors ).
user_story: As a control engineer, I want the control behaviour defined when the position limits stay out of range longer than the fault tolerance time, so that a failing position feedback is handled.
technical_task: When the plausibility check of the position limits (voltage value position feedback unit) is out of the specified range for longer than the fault tolerance time, apply the defined control behaviour: threshold, error message, temporal resolution and temporal correction of errors.
acceptance_criteria: Given the plausibility check of the position limits is out of range for longer than the fault tolerance time, when it is evaluated, then the defined control behaviour is applied.
Given the control behaviour, when it is reviewed, then it defines the threshold, error message, temporal resolution and temporal correcting of errors.
rationale: Role assumed: control engineer. The values are not given.

requirement_text: System shall save the application status as "Payment Pending" in the database.
user_story: As an applicant, I want my application saved with the status Payment Pending, so that I can see payment is awaited.
technical_task: Store the application status as "Payment Pending" in the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application awaiting payment, when its status is saved, then it is stored as "Payment Pending" in the database.
Given a saved application, when it is viewed, then its status shows "Payment Pending".
rationale: Role assumed: applicant. When the status is set is not stated.

requirement_text: The code shall be accompanied by proper test cases to identify and address any errors during production.
user_story: As a quality manager, I want the code to come with test cases, so that errors can be found and fixed in production.
technical_task: Deliver test cases with the code that cover its functions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the delivered code, when it is reviewed, then test cases accompany it.
Given an error in production, when the test cases are run, then the error can be identified.
rationale: Role assumed: quality manager. "Proper" is not defined.

requirement_text: Condition: According specified field of views; see [MMS213-74] for details.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment pointing to a document and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What are the specified field of views in [MMS213-74]?

requirement_text: System shall be easy to learn.
clarification_questions: How long may it take a user to learn the system?
Which user group and which tasks count?

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to preview data within Data Packages before download.
user_story: As a data consumer, I want to preview the data within a Data Package before downloading it, so that I know what I will get.
technical_task: Add a preview of the contents of a Data Package before download.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package, when the user opens the preview, then the data within it is shown.
Given the preview is shown, when the user has not downloaded, then no download has started.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to create a customized workout plan, with a detailed graph of the workout displayed.
user_story: As a fitness user, I want to create a customized workout plan and see a detailed graph of the workout, so that I can follow my progress.
technical_task: Provide customized workout plan creation and show a detailed graph of the workout.
acceptance_criteria: Given the workout screen, when the user creates a customized workout plan, then it is saved.
Given a workout plan, when the user opens it, then a detailed graph of the workout is displayed.

requirement_text: A commercial database shall manage the data while the application server handles the website.
user_story: As a system architect, I want a commercial database to manage the data and the application server to handle the website, so that responsibilities are separated.
technical_task: Use a commercial database for data management and an application server for the website.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system's data, when it is managed, then a commercial database holds it.
Given the website, when it is served, then the application server handles it.

requirement_text: System shall store archived data on existing storage systems for consistency and maintainability.
user_story: As an archivist, I want archived data stored on existing storage systems, so that it stays consistent and maintainable.
technical_task: Place archived data on the existing storage systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given archived data, when it is stored, then it is stored on an existing storage system.
Given the storage setup, when it is reviewed, then no new storage system is required for archived data.

requirement_text: System shall provide role-based control for functionalities within the system.
user_story: As an administrator, I want role-based control of functionalities, so that each role only uses what it should.
technical_task: Control access to each function by user role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function permitted for a role, when a user with that role uses it, then it is available.
Given a function not permitted for a role, when a user with that role tries it, then it is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall be maintainable through modular code structure, allowing for easy future modifications by separating functionalities into subscenes within the main Flash game.
user_story: As a game developer, I want the Flash game built from modular code with functionalities separated into subscenes in the main game, so that changes are easier later.
technical_task: Structure the main Flash game so that its functionalities are separated into subscenes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the main Flash game, when its structure is reviewed, then functionalities are separated into subscenes.
Given a change to one functionality, when it is made, then other subscenes need little or no change.
rationale: Role assumed: game developer. "Easy" modification is not measured.

requirement_text: System shall be designed with better component design to ensure better performance during peak times.
rationale: "Better component design" and "better performance" are comparative and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What is a "better" component design than what baseline?
What performance target applies at peak times?

requirement_text: Whenever a power-on reset occurs, System Initialization shall perform the following functions.
requirement_text_raw: Whenever a power-on reset occurs, System Initialization shall [SRS194] perform the following functions.
rationale: The sentence announces a list of functions that is not included.
clarification_questions: Which functions must System Initialization perform?
Is the list of functions missing from the sentence?

requirement_text: User shall have the option to add advertisements on the website by providing necessary specifications about the property.
user_story: As a property owner, I want to add advertisements on the website by giving the necessary property specifications, so that my property is advertised.
technical_task: Provide an advertisement form that takes the necessary specifications about the property.
acceptance_criteria: Given the advertisement form, when the user enters the property specifications and submits, then the advertisement is added to the website.
Given an advertisement, when it is shown, then it displays the specifications entered.

requirement_text: The system shall generate reports on car information upon request.
user_story: As a fleet manager, I want reports on car information on request, so that I can review the cars.
technical_task: Generate a car information report when a user requests it.
acceptance_criteria: Given car information in the system, when the user requests a report, then the report is generated.
Given the report, when it is opened, then it shows car information.

requirement_text: An HCP can create a lab procedure for a given office visit .
user_story: As an HCP, I want to create a lab procedure for an office visit, so that tests are ordered.
technical_task: Allow an HCP to add a lab procedure to a chosen office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given an office visit, when the HCP creates a lab procedure for it, then the lab procedure is saved for that visit.
Given a saved lab procedure, when the office visit is viewed, then the lab procedure is listed.

requirement_text: User shall assign certain functions to different modules for security.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want to assign certain functions to different modules, so that functions are separated for security.
technical_task: Allow functions to be assigned to separate modules.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function, when the user assigns it to a module, then the assignment is saved.
Given two functions assigned to different modules, when they run, then they are separated.
rationale: Role assumed: security engineer. Which functions are meant is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall send a feedback form to users after the journey for them to share their feedback.
user_story: As a traveler, I want a feedback form sent to me after my journey, so that I can share my feedback.
technical_task: Send a feedback form to each user after a journey.
acceptance_criteria: Given a journey has ended, when the system processes the end of the journey, then a feedback form is sent to the user.
Given a feedback form, when the user fills it in and submits, then the feedback is saved.

requirement_text: The system is not designed for emergency medical use; in case of an emergency, users should contact emergency services such as 108 or their primary doctor.
rationale: The sentence states a limitation of the system rather than behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a disclaimer?
What must the system do in an emergency, if anything?

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to save spreadsheets in various file formats (e.g., XLSX, XLS).
user_story: As a user, I want to save spreadsheets in various file formats such as XLSX or XLS, so that I can share them.
technical_task: Offer saving of spreadsheets in several file formats including XLSX and XLS.
acceptance_criteria: Given a spreadsheet, when the user saves it as XLSX, then an XLSX file is produced.
Given a spreadsheet, when the user saves it as XLS, then an XLS file is produced.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "E.g." means other formats may exist.

requirement_text: Administrator shall have the capability to remove any book from the library.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to remove any book from the library, so that obsolete books are no longer listed.
technical_task: Allow administrators to delete any book from the library.
acceptance_criteria: Given a book in the library, when the administrator removes it, then it is no longer in the library.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to remove a book, then it is not removed.

requirement_text: During dynamic situations a faster voltage measurement is required that is always recalibrated by the more precise sum of single cell voltages in stable and nondynamic phases.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want a faster voltage measurement in dynamic situations that is always recalibrated by the more precise sum of single cell voltages in stable phases, so that measurement stays accurate.
technical_task: Use a faster voltage measurement during dynamic situations and recalibrate it from the more precise sum of single cell voltages in stable and nondynamic phases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dynamic situation, when voltage is measured, then the faster voltage measurement is used.
Given a stable and nondynamic phase, when the sum of single cell voltages is available, then the faster voltage measurement is recalibrated by it.

requirement_text: The polygon shall consist of 30 sampling points wherein the sampling point with the largest distance in driving direction signalized on bus with signal `` DTR_PolyRightXmax ''.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the polygon to consist of 30 sampling points, with the point farthest in driving direction signalized on the bus as DTR_PolyRightXmax, so that the extent is known.
technical_task: Build the polygon from 30 sampling points and signal the point with the largest distance in driving direction on the bus with the signal DTR_PolyRightXmax.
acceptance_criteria: Given the polygon, when it is created, then it consists of 30 sampling points.
Given the polygon, when the bus signal is sent, then the sampling point with the largest distance in driving direction is signalized with DTR_PolyRightXmax.

requirement_text: Selecting multiple encounters will allow you to generate batch files for many claims at once.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to select multiple encounters and generate batch files for many claims at once, so that billing is faster.
technical_task: Allow several encounters to be selected and produce batch files for their claims in one action.
acceptance_criteria: Given several selected encounters, when the clerk generates batch files, then batch files for those claims are produced.
Given no selected encounters, when the clerk generates batch files, then no batch file is produced.

requirement_text: System shall ensure response time between requests and completion is minimal.
clarification_questions: Which requests and which completion events does this measure?

requirement_text: A moderator shall be able to enter in teasers.
user_story: As a moderator, I want to enter teasers, so that I can promote content.
technical_task: Provide a way for moderators to enter teasers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a moderator, when the moderator enters a teaser, then it is saved.
Given a saved teaser, when it is viewed, then it shows the entered text.
rationale: Role stated: moderator. What a teaser is is not defined.

requirement_text: The graphics card compatibility with minimum requirements shall allow full utilization of Adobe Illustrator's capabilities (benefit).
user_story: As a designer, I want my graphics card to meet the minimum requirements, so that I can use all of Adobe Illustrator's capabilities.
technical_task: Specify the minimum graphics card requirements needed to fully use Adobe Illustrator.
acceptance_criteria: Given a graphics card that meets the minimum requirements, when Adobe Illustrator is used, then all its capabilities can be used.
Given a graphics card that does not meet the minimum requirements, when Adobe Illustrator is used, then full use of its capabilities is not guaranteed.
rationale: Role assumed: designer. The minimum requirements are not given.

requirement_text: System shall determine when reported temperature exceeds specified limits and generate appropriate alarms.
user_story: As an operator, I want an alarm when the reported temperature exceeds the specified limits, so that I can react.
technical_task: Compare reported temperature with the specified limits and raise an alarm when a limit is exceeded.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reported temperature above the specified limits, when the system evaluates it, then an alarm is generated.
Given a reported temperature within the specified limits, when the system evaluates it, then no alarm is generated.
rationale: Role assumed: operator. The limits are not given.

requirement_text: Load modules of the four FCPs shall be identical.
requirement_text_raw: Load modules of the four FCPs shall (3.3.11.1) be identical.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the load modules of the four FCPs to be identical, so that all FCPs behave the same.
technical_task: Use the same load module on all four FCPs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the four FCPs, when their load modules are compared, then they are identical.
Given a load module that differs on one FCP, when it is compared, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The system shall use a best-effort multicast/broadcast approach, where delivery of packets to all specified agents is not guaranteed.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want a best-effort multicast and broadcast approach in which delivery to all agents is not guaranteed, so that the system stays simple.
technical_task: Implement multicast and broadcast on a best-effort basis without guaranteeing delivery to all specified agents.
acceptance_criteria: Given a multicast or broadcast message, when it is sent, then it is sent on a best-effort basis.
Given a specified agent that does not receive the message, when delivery is reviewed, then no guarantee of delivery was promised.
rationale: Role assumed: network engineer. The benefit (simplicity) is inferred.

requirement_text: Customers shall navigate menus and add items to their cart.
user_story: As a customer, I want to navigate menus and add items to my cart, so that I can order.
technical_task: Provide menu navigation and an add-to-cart function.
acceptance_criteria: Given the menus, when the customer navigates them, then the items are shown.
Given an item, when the customer adds it to the cart, then it appears in the cart.

requirement_text: The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'
user_story: As a security officer, I want only users with the appropriate access level to start dispute requests, so that disputes are controlled.
technical_task: Allow only users with the appropriate access level to initiate dispute requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the appropriate access level, when the user initiates a dispute request, then it is accepted.
Given a user without the appropriate access level, when the user tries to initiate a dispute request, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The Facebook "like" interface shall be according to the Facebook Guidelines.
user_story: As a user, I want the Facebook like interface to follow the Facebook Guidelines, so that it looks familiar.
technical_task: Build the Facebook "like" interface in line with the Facebook Guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Facebook "like" interface, when it is reviewed against the Facebook Guidelines, then it conforms.
Given the Facebook "like" interface, when it is displayed, then it matches the guideline layout.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The guidelines are not quoted.

requirement_text: An instructor can change his/her password only by supplying the existing password.
user_story: As an instructor, I want to change my password only by supplying the existing one, so that nobody else can change it.
technical_task: Require the current password before an instructor's password is changed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an instructor supplying the existing password, when the instructor sets a new password, then the password is changed.
Given an instructor not supplying the existing password, when the instructor tries to set a new password, then the change is refused.

requirement_text: The TCS shall allow the operator to set the LOL delay timer(s) during mission planning.
user_story: As an operator, I want to set the LOL delay timer or timers during mission planning, so that loss of link behaviour is configured.
technical_task: Provide settings in mission planning for the LOL delay timer(s).
acceptance_criteria: Given mission planning, when the operator sets an LOL delay timer, then the value is saved.
Given a saved LOL delay timer, when the mission plan is opened, then the value is shown.

requirement_text: For details about additional logging requirements, the document "Remote Vehicle Data Access" shall be mandatory.
requirement_text_raw: For details about additional logging requirements, the document "Remote Vehicle Data Access" [RD4117] shall be mandatory.
rationale: The sentence declares a document mandatory and gives no requirement itself.
clarification_questions: What are the additional logging requirements in the referenced document?

requirement_text: The campus map shall cover the campus of the TU/e.
user_story: As a visitor, I want the campus map to cover the TU/e campus, so that I can find my way.
technical_task: Make the campus map cover the whole TU/e campus.
acceptance_criteria: Given the campus map, when it is displayed, then the TU/e campus is shown.
Given a building on the TU/e campus, when the map is searched, then the building appears on it.

requirement_text: The tool shall permit sensed data to be input from an electronic file, though not simultaneously with sensed data from external acquisition hardware.
user_story: As an analyst, I want to input sensed data from an electronic file, but not at the same time as from external acquisition hardware, so that data sources do not mix.
technical_task: Support input of sensed data from an electronic file and prevent using it simultaneously with sensed data from external acquisition hardware.
acceptance_criteria: Given an electronic file of sensed data, when the user selects it as the source, then the data is input from the file.
Given sensed data is being input from external acquisition hardware, when the user also selects an electronic file, then simultaneous input is not allowed.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that dataset instances created by apps are available as sinks and sources for pipelines.
user_story: As an app developer, I want dataset instances created by apps to be available as sinks and sources for pipelines, so that apps and pipelines can share data.
technical_task: Expose dataset instances created by apps as sources and sinks in pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset instance created by an app, when a pipeline is configured, then the dataset is available as a source.
Given a dataset instance created by an app, when a pipeline is configured, then the dataset is available as a sink.

requirement_text: The system shall allow the user to specify an ascending or descending sorting order when viewing meetings.
user_story: As a user, I want to sort meetings ascending or descending, so that I can order them as I like.
technical_task: Add an ascending or descending sort option to the meetings view.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of meetings, when the user selects ascending, then the meetings are ordered ascending.
Given a list of meetings, when the user selects descending, then the meetings are ordered descending.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The sort key is not stated.

requirement_text: System components such as modem, memory, disk, and drives shall be easily serviceable without vault access.
user_story: As a technician, I want the modem, memory, disk and drives to be serviceable without vault access, so that maintenance does not need the vault.
technical_task: Mount components such as the modem, memory, disk and drives so they can be serviced without entering the vault.
acceptance_criteria: Given a modem, memory, disk or drive, when it is serviced, then no vault access is needed.
Given the system layout, when it is reviewed, then these components can be reached from outside the vault.
rationale: Role assumed: technician. "Easily" is not measured.

requirement_text: System shall validate the provided details.
user_story: As a user, I want the details I provide validated, so that errors are caught early.
technical_task: Validate the details entered by the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid details, when the user submits them, then they are accepted.
Given invalid details, when the user submits them, then they are rejected with an indication.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The details and rules are not specified.
